GRASP_CLUSTER.legacy: right robot hand: grasp tomato truss.
GRASP_CLUSTER.en: Grasp the tomato truss securely with the right hand.

PRESENT_CLUSTER.legacy: right robot hand: lift tomato truss to the center.
PRESENT_CLUSTER.en: Lift the tomato truss to the center with the right hand.
PRESENT_CLUSTER.zh: 用右手提起番茄串并移至中间位置。

APPROACH_AND_GRASP.legacy: left robot hand: approach and grasp one tomato; right robot hand: hold truss.
APPROACH_AND_GRASP.en: Approach and grasp one tomato with the left hand while holding the truss steady with the right hand.
APPROACH_AND_GRASP.zh: 用左手接近并抓紧一颗番茄，同时用右手稳定托持番茄串。

DETACH_AND_PLACE.legacy: left robot hand: detach tomato and place it in the left tray; right robot hand: hold truss.
DETACH_AND_PLACE.en: Detach the tomato and place it in the left tray with the left hand while holding the truss steady with the right hand.
DETACH_AND_PLACE.zh: 用左手摘下番茄并放入左侧果盘，同时用右手稳定托持番茄串。

RETURN_AND_RELEASE.legacy: right robot hand: return tomato truss to the right white plate and release it.
RETURN_AND_RELEASE.en: Return the tomato truss to the right white plate and release it with the right hand.
RETURN_AND_RELEASE.zh: 用右手将番茄串放回右侧白盘并松手。

REORIENT_STEM.legacy: right robot hand: move and rotate the tomato stem with its fingers.
REORIENT_STEM.en: Move and rotate the tomato stem using the fingers of the right hand.
REORIENT_STEM.zh: 用右手手指移动并旋转番茄杆。

END.legacy: both robot hands: remain still in low resting positions.
END.en: Keep both hands still in their low resting positions.
END.zh: 让双手在低位休息姿态保持静止。
